2026_01_BAL_IND.headline: Baltimore’s quarterback edge meets an Indianapolis protection test
2026_01_BAL_IND.paragraph1: Baltimore brings Lamar Jackson and Derrick Henry into Indianapolis, where the Colts are starting Daniel Jones after his Achilles recovery. The Ravens’ rushing threat can punish light boxes and turn broken structure into explosive gains, while Indianapolis needs Jonathan Taylor and a controlled passing plan to keep the game out of Jackson’s preferred tempo. With Baltimore missing interior disruptor Nnamdi Madubuike, the Colts have a better chance to stay balanced, but protection and third-down efficiency remain the central stress points.
2026_01_BAL_IND.model_rationale: Baltimore has the stronger quarterback-driven ceiling, while Indianapolis needs efficient protection, a productive run game and disciplined third downs to keep the matchup compressed.
